falsifiers: Complete implementation records show that the apparent public gap is only a publication artifact and that affected people consistently received and used recourse.
Compatible case-level outcome records show no meaningful relationship between formal control and access, correction, payment, or changed outcome.
A documented subgroup comparison shows the burden or benefit is distributed differently from the bounded interpretation.
next_test: Obtain and code the first missing implementation record in each core case, beginning with Workado notice delivery, CMG payment/fund execution, the 2026 Amazon Flex Zelle distribution, and Rytr post-reversal exposure or conduct; retain separate denominators and outcome units.
boundary: This map connects a bounded Trend-hunting synthesis to its pinned input artifacts and any URLs found inside them. Synthesis remains interpretation and signal inventory; it does not establish prevalence, causality, adoption, or outcomes, and shared publishers require independence review.
